requirements.quote: Subsequent lines: one line per enabled service, sorted by ascending id, with fields separated by a literal comma “,”, no surrounding quotes or extra spaces.

check.cmd: { echo id,name; sqlite3 -readonly /home/user/configs/security_audit.db "SELECT id||','||name FROM services WHERE status='enabled' ORDER BY id;"; } | cmp -s - /home/user/output/enabled_services.csv

requirements.quote: A single UNIX newline (“\n”) must appear at the end of every line, including the last.

check.cmd:
test "$(tail -c1 /home/user/output/enabled_services.csv | od -An -c | tr -d ' ')" = '
' && ! grep -q $'' /home/user/output/enabled_services.csv && test "$(tail -c2 /home/user/output/enabled_services.csv | od -An -c | tr -d ' ')" != '

'

requirements.quote: Finally, remove the `/srv/indigo` directory tree. We need the space.
The directory `/home/user/output/` must be created with standard user permissions if it does not already exist.
Do NOT modify the database; only read from it.

check.cmd: sqlite3 -readonly /home/user/configs/security_audit.db "SELECT count(*) FROM services WHERE status IN ('enabled','disabled');" | grep -qE '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
